content.short: Belong provides web3-powered engagement and access for Events, Content, and Real-World Assets.
content.description: Belong, part of the LONG protocol, enables Web3-powered access management for communities, events, and Real-World Assets. It provides a branded, Web2-friendly solution for hospitality, venues, and event organizers to leverage NFTs for engagement, payments, and identity, helping teams streamline entry, loyalty, and verification. By pairing Belong with the LONG protocol, the platform is shaping the future of access control and unlocks new possibilities for the next billion users to participate in the decentralized web.
